'''Shadda-Ul-Haru''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Shadda (star)|Shadda]] in the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran system]], located in the [[Toblain sector/Legends|Toblain sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Shadda-Ul-Haru had eight [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and, along with [[Shadda-Ul-Morn]], was one of the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran system]], except [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
